prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Last spring I ended up in Shanghai for a couple days, and I remember casually chatting about what movies were on around town.
That same trip was tied to taking the train route from Beijing to Shanghai—nothing dramatic, just the usual shuffle.
I still laugh because the movie we talked about was literally called "YOLO", and we went to Shanghai Film Center for it.
We caught the 20:30 show, and it was just one seat—nothing like those big group outings.
Oh, and the booking details were kind of split: the ticket was under Deng Hui, and the train was G3 on 2025-03-21 for Sun Lei in Second Class.
